episode.showDescription: Each week we choose a theme. Then anything can happen. This American Life is true stories that unfold like little movies for radio. Personal stories with funny moments, big feelings, and surprising plot twists. Newsy stories that try to capture what it’s like to be alive right now. It’s the most popular weekly podcast in the world, and winner of the first ever Pulitzer Prize for a radio show or podcast. Hosted by Ira Glass and produced in collaboration with WBEZ Chicago.

transcript_window.text: So many months ago, Nicole reached out to me to ask if I wanted to hear everything that happened after the article was published.
She thought all the people who read her original essay 10 years ago and thought about it and talked to her about it and passed it on to others deserved to know how it actually turned out.
And she thought her daughter, Naja, deserved a chance to share her perspective too.
She had a lot she wanted to say about this and she's a very different take from her moms.

What you're going to hear is a series of conversations that took place before Nicole published her recent New York Times article as she was trying to figure out in real time what she would write about all this.
